name: Hello World
description: A minimal StreetUI application (basic client+SSR starter).
preview: A single Hello World page with a reactive counter and input.

name: Complete App
description: A small full application with routing, forms, and hydration (SSR starter).
preview: Home and About routes, a greeting form, and a counter.

name: Counter
description: A counter demo with increment, decrement, reset, and step size.
preview: Interactive counter with step control and derived state display.

name: Todo List
description: A todo list application with add, remove, and toggle functionality.
preview: Manage tasks with add, complete, and delete actions.

name: Form Validation
description: A form with input validation, error messages, and submission handling.

name: Routing

preview: Navigate between multiple pages using signal-based routing.

name: Signals Demo
description: A signals and derived state demo showcasing reactive computations.

name: Components
description: A reusable components demo with composable UI elements.
preview: Three cards with independent counters demonstrating component reuse.

name: Data Fetching

name: Interactive Widgets
